QuestInfo.name: Someone Suspicious
QuestInfo.0: Speak with #bRondo#k, the suspicious person you met on the Six Path Crossway.
QuestInfo.1: The suspicious person blocking the Interdimensional Portal completely ignores you, even when you tap his shoulder. Tap harder.
QuestInfo.2: Oops, you tapped so hard that Rondo's hat flew off to reveal...animal ears?

1.0: What did you do to my hat? You think you're better than me or something?! \r\n#L0##b(Whoa, his hat was covering some rather interesting-looking ears...)#l\n#k
1.1: Ugh. Nobody look at me! I need to find a place to hide.
